topic: Why boat engines are measured in hours, not kilometres

phrases: Your car counts kilometres. So why does a boat count hours?
Because a boat has no wheels touching the road.
Pushing into a strong current, the engine works hard, but the boat barely moves.
Idling at the dock, it runs and goes nowhere. Distance would lie.
So an hour meter simply counts every minute the engine is running.
That's why services are planned in hours.
Many outboards, for example, need an oil change about every hundred hours.
And when you buy a used boat, hours show how hard the engine has worked.
But low hours are not always good news.
An engine that sits for years can suffer old fuel, dry seals and corrosion.
A busy engine with full service records is often the safer buy.
So always ask why the hours are low, and ask to see the service history.
How many hours are on your engine? Tell us in the comments.

cover_text: BOATS DON'T COUNT KM — WHY HOURS?
caption_en:
Your car counts kilometres. So why does a boat count hours? ⏱️🚤
1 · A boat has no wheels on a road. Pushing into a strong current, the engine works hard but the boat barely moves. Idling at the dock, it runs and goes nowhere. Distance would lie, so an hour meter counts every minute the engine is running.
2 · That's why services are planned in hours: many outboards need an oil change about every 100 hours. And when you buy a used boat, hours show how hard the engine has worked.
3 · The catch: low hours aren't always good news. An engine that sits for years can suffer old fuel, dry seals and corrosion. A busy engine with full service records is often the safer buy, so always ask why the hours are low and ask to see the service history.
How many hours are on your engine? Tell us in the comments 👇 Follow Creative Tracks Marine for a new boat explainer every 2 days.
caption_ar:
سيارتك تحسب الكيلومترات… فلماذا يحسب القارب الساعات؟ ⏱️🚤
١ · القارب لا يملك عجلات على طريق. عند الإبحار عكس تيار قوي يعمل المحرك بجهد كبير والقارب بالكاد يتحرك، وعند تشغيله وهو مربوط على الرصيف يعمل دون أن يقطع أي مسافة. المسافة هنا مضلِّلة، لذلك يحسب عدّاد الساعات كل دقيقة يعمل فيها المحرك.
٢ · لهذا تُجدوَل الصيانة بالساعات: كثير من المحركات الخارجية تحتاج تغيير الزيت كل ١٠٠ ساعة تقريبًا. وعند شراء قارب مستعمل، تُظهر الساعات مقدار الجهد الذي بذله المحرك.
٣ · لكن انتبه: قلة الساعات ليست دائمًا خبرًا جيدًا. المحرك الذي يبقى متوقفًا لسنوات قد يعاني من وقود قديم وجوانات جافة وتآكل. المحرك المستخدم كثيرًا مع سجل صيانة كامل غالبًا هو الخيار الأكثر أمانًا، فاسأل دائمًا لماذا الساعات قليلة واطلب الاطلاع على سجل الصيانة.
